item.title: Pound Sterling Price News and Forecast: GBP/USD edges lower to around 1.3610 early Asian session
item.description: The GBP/USD pair trades on a softer note around 1.3605 during the early European session on Monday. Growing expectation of the Bank of England’s (BoE) interest-rate cut weighs on the Pound Sterling (GBP) against the Greenback.

item.title: US Dollar Index remains subdued near 97.50 as traders await key economic data
item.description: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which measures the value of the US Dollar (USD) against six major currencies, extends its losses for the second successive session and is trading near 97.60 during the Asian hours on Monday.

item.title: Asian stocks soar as Nikkei 225 hits new record high
item.description: Asian equities trade high on Monday, while the Nikkei 225, Japan’s benchmark, soars to a fresh record high following a historic election victory by Japan’s Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi.

item.title: Japanese Yen sticks to gains as bears remain on the sidelines amid intervention talks
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) is looking to build on its strong intraday move up amid speculations that authorities will step in to stem weakness in the domestic currency.

item.title: EUR/USD: Upward pressure expected – UOB
item.description: UOB analysts Quek Ser Leang and Lee Sue Ann suggest that the Euro against the US Dollar is facing mild upward pressure and could test higher levels. The report indicates a potential advance to 1.1840, although the resistance at 1.1860 is unlikely to be breached.

item.title: USD/INR weakens due to US-India trade deal strengthens Rupee
item.description: USD/INR depreciates as the Indian Rupee (INR) finds support from the United States (US)–India interim trade framework. New Delhi and Washington on Friday unveiled an interim framework aimed at lowering tariffs, reshaping energy ties, and deepening economic cooperation.

item.title: Gold remains supported by China's buying and USD weakness as traders eye US data
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) struggles to capitalize on its intraday move up and remains below the $5,100 mark heading into the European session on Monday amid mixed cues. Data released over the weekend showed that the People's Bank of China (PBOC) extended its buying spree for a 15th month in January.
